title: AGENTS.lock v0.1
description: A lockfile for agent behaviour. Records the agent-config surface of a repository in a state that passed review: which instruction files exist, which guardrails they contain, which hooks may auto-run (pinned to the hash of the script they execute) and which MCP servers the agent may talk to. Signed out-of-band (AGENTS.lock.sig, ed25519 over the canonical JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8). Vendor-neutral: any tool may write or verify it.

generator.description: Tool and version that wrote the lock, e.g. sentinel/0.1

files.description: Every tracked agent-config file, keyed by repository-relative path.

verdict.description: A lock never records COMPROMISED: the signer refuses to sign that state.

guardrails.description: Prohibitions about sensitive actions found in the file. One disappearing is a visible line in the diff.

script_sha256.description: Approval lapses when the script changes.

cassettes.description: Deterministic simulation cassettes pinned to their sha256 hashes.
